balls.text: On a length attacking the stumps, flicked towards fine leg and they'll sneak in one final single

Gill is nonchalant as you like! Ball was fired in on a length and outside wide marker once more. Jansen goes for it anyway, on the back foot and powers it straight to covers. Gill is lying in wait and he has to use his own long arms to grab this one into his dive. He lies on the ground for a few beats but when he gets back up, signals that it's always been out. Whaddagrab
Rashid floats this one into the wide marker, drifting past the batter but he'll have to reload

And now he French cuts it down to deep fine leg... Jansen will take runs any way they come. Rashid goes full and straight, almost crashes into the stumps but the game is a fickle friend. Dribbles away to the vacant ropes

Whaddashot! Rashid turns around and can only watch this one sail over long-off. Once more, it's Jansen's range. The ball was outside off, spinning away, but Jansen can just convert another length ball into a full one with those hands
Jansen hoicks this over to deep cover and they'll run back for two. Was a length ball outside off but with Jansen's hitting range, everything can be hoicked if he wants to
Rashid floats one in full-ish outside off, driven down to long-off but he turns down the single
Jansen keeps it grounded this time. At his pads off a length, right in front of the stumps. Flicked towards deep midwicket and he will keep strike for the 20th...
Full-ish and hoiked down to deep extra cover, mistimed once more and somehow he keeps finding those empty gaps
On a length and tucked down to deep midwicket
On a length and kept farrr away from the batter, which is impressive considering how tall he is. Jansen crouches on both knees and tries to cut it away but misses
On a length and rising at Jansen. He goes for a high-elbowed drive and miscues it once more, in front of long-on

Massive no-look shot from Jansen, and Suthar spills this one at deep square leg... What a comical set of events. Ball was rifled into the slot, Jansen seemingly times the screws out of this one. But the no-look shot doesn't give it the distance it needs, two fielders converge and one of them spills it...
On a length and but drifting down the leg side and Jansen's long legs. Time to reload...
Keeps low once more... On a length and jags back in once more. Defended back to the bowler

Holder is off on his celebratory, knee-pumping jig again! What a delivery from the big man. Was on a length, and this beauty jagged back in and kept just a tad bit low as it zoomed past Bartlett. The batter was too tall and misread the line. Loses his off stump as a result

Stoinis has banged this one straight to Washington Sundar at long-on! Stoinis shuffled deeeep into the off side, expecting this delivery. Back of a length and rose at him, but the angle across him just cramped up the shot. He mistimes this and angry with himself as he walks back to the dugout
On a length but too far past the wide marker, time to reload
Low full toss and Stoinis somehow drags this down to long-off! Was rifled in outside off, and he gets wayyy under the ball and uses his power to hustle it to the ropes
Jansen goes for a slash but without much conviction. On a length at the stumps, and in the end, batter bunts it down to mid-on
Back of a length gliding away from the batter, cut fine down to deep backward point
spears it into the blockhole. Driven down to long-off, 2 for 24 has been absolute gold from Siraj tonight

Stoinis shouts "Come on" at the umpire, then reviews... Quiteee short and well outside off, Stoinis pulls out of the ramp and then lodges a complaint with his verbal volley. Ball was passing 0.04 metres over Stoinis' head height, so umpire reverses his decision
Smart cricket from Stoinis, and he'll find the gap too. Was short and climbing into his chest. He jumps back into the crease and just dabs a late cut down to deep backward point
Speared in full-ish and at the stumps. Jansen uses those longgg arms of this to just drive it down to long-off
Stoinis goes for a huge hoick but mistimes this! Ball falls just short of Suds stationed at long-on. Back of  a length and just climbed at him awkwardly
Short ball that rushes past the batter, 129.1 clicks but feels quicker. Stoinis goes for a jump and a hoick but swishes at air
On a length attacking the stumps, defended down to the left of the bowler, who runs in to collect the delivery

And now it's all over for Shedge. Rabada wins the battle. Back of a length and Shedge goes for a nothing cut, too close to his body especially with that bounce on the delivery. Edge goes to the keeper and Shedge seems displeased with himself, as he should be. Job was left to be done and now PBKS are six down. Rabada fell over in his follow-through and aurafarms after the dismissal, as he summersaults back up to his legs
Another slower one that sticks in the crease... Stoinis checks his drive to turn it into a defense. Flies down to mid-on
Rabada's showing his smarts here. Slower 'un and back of a length outside off, just 119 clicks. Shedge stays deep in his crease and goes for a hoick, mistimes this to a vacant midwicket
Back of a length, he tries to make room and thrash this down the ground but misses once more. Extra bounce on this does the trick for Rabada
And now Rabada pulls this one to back of a length. Moves away just a little. Shedge eyed up a huge loft down the ground but swished at air. Needs to recollect himself
GT are just feeding Shedge. 145 kph but that only helps the batter because it's straying full and down past his pads. Flicked over long leg, he's enjoying himself out there

Whaddaknock from this young player. On a length spinning in, he gets inside the line of the delivery and flicks this down to deep midwicket. He looks remarkably self-assured at the crease right now. Gets to fifty
On a length outside off, cut towards deep cover and Stoinis gets to the other end
On a length attacking the stumps. Rashid collects the defense near the pitch. Rashid threatens to throw the ball back at the stumps. Stoinis gives him a huge stare in return, he isn't amused...
Stoinis wants to get into the action and he does. Floated right in the slot outside off. Stoinis lofts this one with a high elbow, over long-off, no need for a second invitation
On a length and spinning into the pads. Flicked towards backward square leg
Back of a length drifting into the leg side. Driven down to long-on and they come back for two

Oh lord. Fifth consecutive boundary off this over, 27 runs off the over. Another juicy full toss fed off from a bowling machine, Shedge is seeing the ball too well to miss out on this swipe. Middled over cow corner with panache

Another one, oh boy. On a length and right near the wide marker, looking to keep it away from the batter. Shedge reaches out for a cut and almost falls over, but somehow middles and times this to perfection past deep point
Another poor delivery, another great shot... He's climbing into Suthar's bowling here. A juicy full toss floated up outside off, and now Shedge drives it straight through to deep covers

And now he proves a sequel can be better than the original! Floated in even fuller. Batter reduces the motion in his follow-through to just the huge swipe across the line. Played over long-on once more
Iyer-esque strike down the ground! Was floated into the slot, outside off. He stood deep in his crease and rolls those lavish wrists as he shuttles this ball over long-on
On a length and spinning into the batter. Driven down to mid-off
Now it's too short. Moving away from the batter way outside off, but it might as well be a satellite because of how far above the batter's eyeline it sails through
Poor back of a length delivery, and all Stoinis has to do is pull out a big swivel pull. On one knee as he plays this late and fine, down to deep fine leg
He keeps shuffling into the leg side, the bowler keeps following him. Swung into his pads, and he flicks this down to deep fine leg
And now he runs down the pitch! Lucky to land in a vacant spot near deep extra cover. Was banged in back of a length again, Shedge did not middle this by any stretch of the imagination

Wonderful timing on this, ball travels a longgg way into the crowd. Was too short, banged into the surface and rising right at the batter. Shedge stays deep in his crease and pulls this over deep square
Shedge goes for a huge hoick by shuffling into the leg side, but swishes at air! Misread the bounce on this length ball shuttling down leg side
A big dive from Rashid saves this ball from being dribbling past him. Was driven outside off
Attacking the stumps and an intelligent defence back to the bowler
Short-ish and pulled on the bounce to deep midwicket
Long hop and pulled towards deep midwicket! But not timed well on the pull
Rashid lets this one be driven right past him. Was full-ish attacking the stumps, and he fell in his follow-through as he tried to collect that
Full outside off, bunted down to deep cover
And now a bouncer, but not too lethal at 128.8 kph. Keeps it outside off, Stoinis does well to jump on his feet just a little as he swipes it down to deep midwicket
And now intentional placement to get it to the ropes again! Was back of length, just enough width outside off for him to flay his hands at this. Middles a cut straight to deep point
And now a French cut runs down to vacant deep fine leg! Stoinis goes for a huge hoick across the line, but the ball takes the underedge from back of a length, and down to the ropes
Pushes the ball a little fuller but still moves in from outside off. Comfortable drive straight to the covers cordon
Defended down to covers. Was back of a length outside off and moving in. Jumps on his feet and drives this from in front of the stumps
Back of a length outside off, glided to backward point
Fuller on middle and leg, he eases to long-on
Fullish on off stump, Stoinis goes reverse now and only mistimes this towards point
Marginally fuller on off and middle, he turns this to deep midwicket for a run
Quicker and fuller on off stump, he pushes to long-on
Lovely work from Gill. Flatter on leg, he paddles this fine but Gill is up to the task and runs to his left from slip, dives and saves two
Darts the length ball on off, he pushes to long-on
Back of a length ball on off, he stands tall and defends

HUUUGE appeal for lbw. The umpire is unmoved. Did Stoinis get an inside-edge? If not this looks plumb. Will GT review. They have to, isn't it? Yes, they do. Oh, big inside-edge and Stoinis survives. Length ball on off, he gets a thick inside-edge onto pad. Stoinis is all smiles as GT burn a review

Chopped on and Iyer has to go back! Holder gets into the act. PBKS in all sorts now. Rising back of a length ball on off stump at 134.6kph. Iyer wants to run that fine but that's too close to his body. He gets a thin inside-edge and the bails light up. Iyer has a long look at the pitch, but that won't change the result.
On a length around off stump, he pushes with soft hands past cover for a run
Back of a length ball on leg stump, he pulls to deep square leg
Good length ball outside off stump, he stands tall and punches to backward point
Six off Arshad's first over. On a length on middle stump, he gets across and defends back towards the bowler
Goes fuller outside off stump, Shedge pushes firmly with a straight face of the bat but only as far as mid-off
On a length on middle and leg, he shuffles across and turns this to deep backward square leg
On a length down leg, he works this to deep backward square leg for a run
Gets lucky and gets four. Shedge won't mind though. Back of a length ball outside off, he looks for a pull, gets an under-edge and the ball just evades the off pole and the keeper
Starts off with a good length ball on off, he defends back to the bowler
Rising back of a length ball outside off, he rides the bounce and punches past backward point for a run
back of a length ball outside off stump, he stands tall and flat-bats to long-on
On a length angling away from Shedge outside off, he steers with an open face of the bat to deep third

Oh, that's a poor shot and Wadhera's struggles continue. He falls for a six-ball duck. Lovely lines from Holder. On a length with a hint of nibble away from Wadhera, who feels for it, gets a thick outside edge and Buttler does the rest diving to his left. Holder is off on a celebratory run. Look at him go!
Charges down the track to the length ball on leg stump rather outside off. He gets a thin inside-edge onto pad with the ball lobbing to the keeper on the bounce
On a length down leg, he works this through square leg for a run
A wicket-maiden to end the powerplay. And what a stop from Washy. Length ball nibbling away Wadhera outside off, he carves this to the right of backward point, who dives to his right and saves four
Length ball spearing away from Wadhera outside off, he shoulders arms
And now a 148.8kph bouncer! Don't you love it! Not if you are Wadhera, you don't. Banged in short on middle, he somehow ducks under
And he gets a jaffa first up. On a length at 147kph decking away from Wadhera outside off. He has to play that on line, commits and gets beaten

Pace is pace yaar! A 152kph thunderbolt from Rabada and Prabhsimran is walking back for 15! On a length on off stump, Prabhsimran wants to go over covers like his captain did in the previous over. Only manages to splice a drive and cover takes the simplest of catches
Sharp back of a length ball outside off stump at 149.6kph.  Prabhsimran wants to steer that fine, is rushed by the pace and is beaten
Takes Siraj on and does it successfully!  On a length outside off, the bat turns in his hand once more as he lofts over covers. Succeeds this time around as he put more power in the shot
Wants a quick single does Iyer but Prabhsimran sends him back. Short of a good length ball on on off and middle, he pushes with soft hands to the offside and sets off. Prabhsimran has his gloves up
On a length on off and middle, he pushes to mid-on
Wants to go up and over but finds no timing. Siraj pushes this fuller on off stump, the bat turns in his hand as he looks to go over mid-off. He meekly gets it to the fielder there
Whippage excellence ft. Shreyas Iyer. Length ball on middle and leg, he shuffles across slightly and flicks this over midwicket
Fuller in length on off stump, he pushes to covers with the bat turning in his hand
Length ball angling away from Iyer outside off, he plays with an open face of the blade to the left of backward point for a run
On a length on off stump, he defends with soft hands quite close to the stumps. Wants a single but is sent back
On a length on off stump, he stays legside of the ball and pats this with an open face of the bat past backward point
gets the ball to cut back into Prabhsimran from outside off, not giving any room. He chops this towards slip
BIIIG swing and a miss! Was in his slot but Prabhsimran couldn't lay a bat on it. Full outside off stump, he looks to hammer that out of Ahmedabad but misses. Rabada with a wry smile

oh, so much has happened on this ball! A Wayward length ball down leg with the ball continuing down leg. Buttler dives to his left and gets a glove to it with the ball ricocheting towards slip. Sudharsan there fires a throw at the non-striker's end and Iyer would have been a goner with a direct hit. Lots happening!
Oof, Rabada is getting the ball to talk! Gets this fuller just outside off stump with some nibble away from Iyer, who goes fishing for it and gets beaten
Another indecker on middle and leg stump, Iyer works this behind square on the leg side for a run
On a length spearing back into Prabhsimran on off stump, he pushes to mid-off and sets off
Length ball with a hint of the movement away from Iyer who opens the face of the blade and steers to the right of short third
Length ball on the pads of Prabhsimran who works this to deep backward square leg
Short of a good length ball outside off, he drives aerially and not off the middle of the bat but in the gap through covers for a couple of runs
How's that missed the off stump? On a length outside off stump, getting that to seam back into Prabhsimran, who reaches for it and gets beaten. The ball is perilously close to the off pole
Jaffa to end the second over. Length ball that lands on off stump and decks away past Iyer's outside edge
Sharp back of a length ball on leg stump, he gets rapped on the thigh pad with the ball going to the on-side
Ooh, movement for Rabada. Short of a good length ball that starts on off and decks back into Prabhsimran who just about keeps this out to the offside
Back of a length ball outside off, he cuts this past backward point and Siraj at deep third dives and saves two
Two in two. Wobble seam good length ball outside off stump, he throws his bat it and gets a thickish outside edge that flies past slip and into the fence
He won't take much time to get going! On the fuller side of length outside off stump, he leans forward and thunders through covers
On a length seaming away from Iyer outside off, he defends with an angled face
Iyer is away, stylishly! Length ball with a hint of movement away from Iyer, who drives on the up through covers
On a length outside off stump, he square drives aerially but only as far as backward point

Oh, does Siraj have two in two? Buttler is up in appeal right away. The umpire takes his time and gives him caught behind. Connolly isn't sure and chats with Prabhsimran before going up. Excellent first ball from Siraj. Good length ball that starts just around off and decks back sharply into Connolly. He drives on the up, and replays confirm there is a thin inside-edge through to Buttler.

If he doesn't get you on the first, he'll get you with his second. Mo Siraj with a first strike! Back of a length delivery outside off. He carves it but not in the gap. Nishant Sindhu, on debut, runs to his left, dives and takes a lovely catch at deep backward point.

A wicket first ball? Oh, almost. Jos Buttler with a valiant dive but to no avail. He runs back, dives but can't reach the ball. Short of a length on middle stump, he hooks but gets a big top-edge with the ball going around the short fine leg region. The fine leg fielder is very square. So Buttler runs back, puts in a sprawling dive, but not to be

And Washington has wrapped it up like only he can! Stoinis tries the yorker once more, but he lobs up a juicy full toss on the stumps. Washington drops to one knee and lobs this down to deep fine leg. Relieved faces in the GT dugout, heartbreak writ all over Stoinis' face. His plans were a little all over the place, but in the end, what matters for GT is that they've squeezed out 11 runs from a thrilling final over

It's all happening here! Absolutely picture-perfect yorker, and squeezed into his pads. Stoinis runs in to collect, throws it to the non-striker's. Misses. A dive from Arshad ensures he can't get back up to attempt a second
Oooo, now he's finally gone for the line that has worked for PBKS in these death overs. Back of a length, kept outside off, and Arshad swings at fresh air
Shidge pulls off a Superman dive to keep this game alive! Was another full ball right on the pads, deserved to be put away. Flicked towards a vacant deep backward point but Shidge's dive saves two

Arshad has squeezed this one away! Stoinis lands it right in the blockhole but it's right in front of the pads. Arshad flicks this to deep fine leg, which is lying empty with the fielder stationed way deeper inside
Shorttt, too short! And that's one run struck off for Stoinis to defend. Sailed well over the batter's head
Arshad goes for another big swipe down the ground. Doesn't middle this back of a length ball, goes down to long-on

Wowwww, do we have a plot twist after all! Connolly has taken a magnificent catch down at cow corner. He runs in and scoops the ball up in his hands, and slides in the grass on his stomach to rub it in for GT. Was back of a length and Holder swiped across the line. For a moment, looked like he'd send it over the ropes, but it held in the pitch once more. Just didn't get the elevation he needed from this
Washington just isn't finding his timing here. Pitch has turned as slow as ever. Outside off, back of a length, holding in the pitch just a little as he swipes across the line. Down to long-on
Back of a length and moving away to just outside off. Glided off the bat late, towards deep backward point

Steps into the off side with that big stride of his, allows him to get in line for this delivery on the stumps. Flicked down to midwicket, and he runs back for a risky two. Two more shaved off this target
On a length outside off, Washington happy to drive it down to covers for another single
Another silky straight drive, high elbow. But driven right back to Bartlett
Another drive to covers. Full-ish outside off, Holder looks elegant, but elegance alone can't pierce the gap etc.
On a length right outside off. Holder drives this aerially, but falls well short of extra cover
On a length outside off, driven down to deep extra cover
Hurried on the extra bounce there. Short and rising at his shoulder, down to deep midwicket

How has he bunted it down to long-on! Was back of a length, on the stumps and angling away from him. Would cramp most batters. But not Washington, who swipes this at the exact angle he needed to beat the fielder running in...

Tewatia has cracked this to Bartlett! He's sunk to his haunches here, in disbelief. Back of a length outside off. He is down on one leg and has absolutely smashed this one. But too flat and picked out deep square leg to perfection
On a length and drifting into the pads. Flicked down to deep fine leg
Full-ish outside off, easy enough flick down to midwicket

Trademark scoop from Washington here! Wayyyy into the off side and he plays this towards deep fine leg, where Vyshak plays hide-and-seek with the ball but looks like he was in touch with the boundary cushion when he eventually managed to push it back into the field

Washington boinks an outside edge down to deep third! Buttler and Gill smile, but nervously, in the dugout. Was on a length and moving away from Washington. He went for a lofted drive but misread the line
On a length and drifting into the pads. Flicked down to deep square
Washington jumps at this one but deceived by a pace-off short one. Flies past his helmet, nothing to do about it once you've missed it
And now Tewatia goes for that trademark hoick of his down leg, but misses. Was speared into his pads off a length, but rushed onto Tewatia
On a length and cramping him up near off stump. Tewatia glides this close to his body, down to backward point. Looks for a run but sent back, never one there
On the stumps and angled away from a full-ish length once more. Flicked down to mid-wicket
Tewatia goes for a late pull, delivery was on a length and rising into him. Deep fine leg in position to cut out the shot
Attacks the line outside off by moving the ball away, full-ish. Defended back to the bowler

And he's almost gone first ball! Vyshak finishing off on a high here. On a length, angling away from Tewatia, who fends at this with a defensive prod. No edge, but for the record, keeper spills it behind the stumps too

Twist in the tale! Angst for GT. Sudharsan was looking so good and had crossed fifty too, but it will feel too little as he pulls this straight to deep square leg. Was a well-directed bouncer rising right at his helmet. Sudharsan went for the pull but just couldn't get under it enough to put it beyond the fielder at the ropes
A late cut down to deep point! And he gets two for his efforts too, scrambling back in time! Rolled his wrists on top of this ball outside off
Iyer misses out on a potential run out. On a length and pitching outside off, threaded down to extra cover, where Iyer can't pick up the ball in his follow-through

That's all class, innit? Not the greatest timing on this lofted drive but it does the job, because he just flows through this shot with that trademark high backlift of his. Was sitting up on a full-ish length outside off and sent to deep extra cover
Back of a length and angled away from outside off. Middles a cut down to deep cover
Pulls the length back slightly, still at the stumps. Flicked down to deep midwicket and Suds more than happy to keep strike here
Sudharsan has played a steady knock today, and now, he might be ramping up the intent! To be fair, it's another hit-me ball, speared into the slot and down leg. He just sweeps it to long leg
On a length but floating down the pads once more. Another flick to deep square leg
On a length at the stumps, slashed to midwicket across the line

Oh no, that's Mr Bean cricket from Arshdeep Singh... Speared into the blockhole and hits the pads. Googly drifting down leg side, and Arshdeep actually puts in a great dive but ends up just pushing the ball into the ropes as he lunges for it...
On a length and spinning into the pads. Flicked out to deep square leg
On a length but drifting onto the pads. Flicks this down to deep midwicket. The ball kept a little low
Pushed slightly fuller, kept outside off. Another fruitless punch down to covers
Punched straight to covers. There to be hit off back of length once more, but the outside off length is just cramping him up at the moment
Keeps probing that channel outside off. Back of a length, and late glide down to backward point
On a good length attacking the stumps, moving back into the batter. Flicked down to deep square leg
Arshdeep employs a back of a length line too. The left-hander bunts this down to mid-on
Back of a length again, now slashed across the line, towards deep midwicket

Washington jumps on both feet and cuts this one to deep point! Was back of a length and sliding away, there to be hit but with just the little extra bounce. He watches this till the last moment and compensates for the bounce with that smart jump
Speared in full. Flicked towards midwicket, well-timed but the fielder stationed there for this exact shot

Sindhu goes for a big slash but he won't have the last laugh! Short and sat up, sliding past his eyeline. He hoicks this and should have sent it over the ropes, really. But it is timed to perfection right to Vyshak, at deep backward point. Seamers in action even when they're not bowling, for PBKS
Sudharsan glides just a little into the leg side, bowler follows him well with a short one. Pulled down to deep square leg
Inside edged into his pads... Great line this, outside off and holding back of a length. Goes for a big hoick over the covers but misreads the trajectory of the ball
Who needs reach when you have that timing! Short ball but not much venom on this, sits up right near Sudharsan's eyeline. he jumps at this, a little, as he ramps this down to deep backward point
Goes for a cut farrr away from his core! Was floated up full-ish and near the wide marker, Sudharsan can't get to this one. He hasn't got those Jansen arms, mesuppose
On a length outside off, bunted down to extra cover and he takes off for the other end
Sindhu has absolutely creamed this one! Vyshak goes for a short ball, rising into him, and Sindhu just swings through the line to deposit it over deep midwicket. Wonderful timing
Goes for a mistimed hoick across the line. On a length outside off and dribbles away to deep midwicket
Full and outside off, driven to covers. Middled this
Length outside off, he pushes to backward point with an open face of the bat

Oh, dear! Sindhu gets away with one. Banged in short on off stump. Sindhu is unsure whether to sway away from the line or pull that. Hangs his bat up and the ball goes straight up close to deep third. Falls short though
Length on middle stump, he is cramped for room and  defends back to the bowler
Gentle back of a length ball outside off, Sindhu stands tall and punches neatly through covers for a couple of runs
Short of a good length ball outside off, he guides this with an angled bat down to deep third
Pace-on length ball on off and middle, he turns this to midwicket
Misses out. Length ball down leg, BSS flicks this neatly but straight to short fine leg
Length ball on off stump, he pushes towards backward point with soft hands and sets off
Length ball angling back sharply into Sindhu, who defends to covers
Fullish outside off, he creams cover drive, but short extra cover does well with a dive to his left
On a length outside off, he drives on the up to sweeper cover for a run

BUTTLER DEPARTS! Vyshak with a timely strike. Is there a way back for PBKS? Buttler jumps down to the length ball on off stump. He wants to go over covers, but the ball doesn't come onto the bat as easily as Buttler expects. He gets it right off the bottom of the bat with the ball going straight up. Iyer runs to his left from mid-off and completes a simple catch
Backs away does Buttler but Stoinis sticks to his guns with a length ball on leg stump. Buttler wants to access the offside, instead gets a thick inside-edge to deep midwicket
Length ball on middle and leg, he turns this to deep backward square leg
Fuller on middle stump, he pushes to long-on with a straight face of the bat
The fifty stand is up between the two off 38 balls. Back of a length ball outside off, he carves it to backward point where the fielder dives but cannot prevent a run
On a length outside off, he steps across and eases to long-on
Length on off stump, he defends to midwicket

Huge, huge appeal for lbw. Not given again. Was that sliding down leg? Think that's the main question. PBKS have one review left, will they go for it? Yes, they are. Ooh, that looks like sliding down. Yep! On a length on leg stump, he gets across looking for a flick and misses. Gets rapped on the pad but the angle but taking the ball down. PBKS are out of reviews.
Back of a length ball angling across BSS, he scythes that to deep cover
Length ball jagging back into Buttler, who gets a thick inside-edge onto the right thigh pad as they sneak a quick run
Banged in short on middle, he pulls but only as far as deep midwicket
On a length around off stump, he opens the face of the bat and runs this to deep third
On a length on middle and leg, he works this neatly to the right of deep backward square leg for a run
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he steers this to deep third. Ends a top powerplay for GT
HE'S PULLED THAT WITH DISDAIN! Back of a length ball on his hips, he gets inside the line of the ball and helps it for an 82m six over deep backward square leg
On a length on off stump, he defends with soft hands
WHAT A PEACH! How's that missed both the outside edge and the offpole? Jansen lands the ball on a length around off stump and gets it to move away from BSS' outside edge late turning him square
Another appeal for a strangle down leg. Not given and this has been called a wide. No review again. Banged in short down leg, he attempts a pull and misses
GT reach 50 inside the powerplay. Short of a good length ball on off and middle, he turns this to the on-side for a run
Buttler eyes the scoop again and misses, one more time. On a length down leg, he gets right across and only connects at thin air

Huge appeal from Bartlett who thinks he has Sai Sudharsan strangled down leg. The umpire is unmoved, and doesn't even call a wide, which means the ball might have flicked his pad. Was a length ball down leg, which Sai Sudharsan failed to get away. No review from either BSS or Bartlett.
Short of a good length ball arching back into Buttler who gets a thick inside-edge onto pad towards the offside. They take a quick run
Buttler looks in the mood. Ominous signs for PBKS.Fractionally short and wide outside off, he opens the face of the blade and creams this past backward point
Big hooping inswinger but the line is down leg and continues to stray further away from the keeper. Five wides is the result
Tries again but misses this time around. X goes fuller on off stump, Buttler shuffles across and looks for a scoop, he can only toe-end this to midwicket
Here comes the Jos special. Length ball outside off stump, he ambles across, gets into position watches the ball onto bat and uses the pace to scoop that over short fine leg for a six
On a length on off stump, he works to midwicket
Super timing and placement for a couple of runs. Back of a length ball outside off, he slices that past backward point for two more
On a length on middle stump, he turns this to midwicket
Ramped over short third for a four. Rising back of a length ball outside off, he rides the bounce, gets under the ball and gets it over the fielder
back of a length ball angling across Buttler who stands tall and punches to the left of extra cover
On a length around off stump, he pushes to mid-on with soft hands and sets off right away
ooh, that's kept a little low. Good length ball outside off stump, he wanted to steer that fine but the ball goes under his bat
On a length angling back into Buttler on off and middle, worked to the on-side

Oh, that's Buttler at his effortless best. And he's sent it for six! Jos the Boss! Nothing wrong with the ball. On the fuller side of length on off, he leans forward, with a full face of the bat and lifts nonchalantly over the long-off fence

Big appeal for lbw. Jansen is confident but the umpire is unmoved. Iyer asks is that high and then goes a review. On a length decking back into Buttler and hits him on the flap of the left pad. Was that high? Was that angling down leg? Let's see. No bat, on we go. Pitching outside off, impact in line but too much bounce. That was comfortably going over the stumps. PBKS lose a review
Back of a length ball outside off, he cuts that neatly but only as far as deep point
On a length angling back into Sai Sudharsan on off stump, he turns this to midwicket
On a length on off stump, he plays this late and close to his body and defends
Length ball shaping away from Buttler outside off, he steers to backward point. An excellent comeback from Arshdeep after the early boundary
On a length angling away form Buttler outside off, who shoulders arms
Length ball on his pads, he flicks this neatly to the left of deep backward square leg

Straight up, straight up and Connolly swallows that up. Arshdeep is off on a celebratory run. Will this be his night? Goes a touch fuller now with a hint of nibble away from Gill. He wanted to go across the line but only manages a top-edge that spoons up. Connolly at backward point takes a comfortable catch
A short arm jab placed and timed to perfection! Back of a length outside off, he flat-bats through midwicket
Fuller in length well outside off angling away from Gill. He reaches for it, driving all along the turf. But cover intercepts to his left with a dive and saves a few runs
Ooh, a leading edge but Gill is away. Length ball with a hint of nibble away from Gill on off. He pushes at it and gets it down to deep third
On a length just around off, he prods forward and pushes to the offside for a quick run
And now to his left. Short and wide outside off, he cuts his hard to the left of Shedge for two more
Short of good length ball slanting across Sai Sudharsan outside off, he steers to the right of deep backward point for a couple of runs
Oh, my word! That is delicious. Fullish in length outside off, he leans forward and creams the most perfect cover drive threading the gap with poise, panache and all that jazz
On a length on middle and leg, he shimmies down the track and works this neatly to the left of midwicket. A misfield from Vyshak and Sai Sudharsan steals a second
